title: UI-pass brief and docs name -render-fixture, its eight fixtures, and the five default render files

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Raised by the ui in round 1 of ork run ork-20261125-131038-69e9 for S499 (discovered from S499):

Tell the UI pass brief about -render-fixture
`internal/engine/brief.go:187-188` gives only `-renders` and still says "This writes status.txt, show.txt and help.txt". Without `-render-fixture` in the brief, a UI pass does not learn of the eight new views, and they do not reach the approval card, which is the slice's purpose. The brief text should name `-render-fixture NAME[,NAME...]` and list the fixture names. It should also say that `-renders` alone writes five files, not three. That file is outside this slice's Files.
Importance: 3
Urgency: 2
Effort: 1

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
